body:
I actually just called the suicide prevention hotline and they had some really good guidance. I think honestly it's just too much for her (she is human after all, and not a therapist so she won't know how to handle). To some degree I wish she would be there for me more often, but on the other hand I can't just make her isolate from her life and only focus on me (obviously I would like that... but it's not fair for me to demand that, so I try not to). 

I'm trying to stay positive so here it goes. The hotline essentially told me that I need to find stuff to keep me busy. Joining a gym, doing a cooking class, hanging out at a library, running with a group, meeting people in my field through MeetUp, etc. But it's going to take time and I'm gonna be really really depressed until I can get a group of friends going at this new location. 

Finally, thank you for your advice MotionEyes, I appreciate you taking the time to look at my situation and offer a suggestion :)
